Ripple 规则库资料出处表 v1.1 新加坡版（2026-10-01）.md
rules: Patient-facing text is our paraphrase with a citation; never copy HealthHub/HPB/MOH sentences.
US label text is reference only and never shown to the patient.
Numbers marked do-not-display in the B4 notes must never appear in output.
zh fields must be human-reviewed before zh_status becomes 'reviewed'.

referrals.section: B1　马上打急救（新加坡 995）
referrals.situation: Possible heart attack: chest pain, pressure or tightness that goes on or keeps coming back; pain spreading to the jaw, neck, back, shoulder or arm; breathlessness; cold sweat; nausea; giddiness
referrals.refer_to: **995** — ring at once, even if unsure; do not drive yourself
referrals.source:
**SG:** Singapore Heart Foundation [Heart attack](https://www.myheart.org.sg/health/heart-conditions/heart-attack/) (ring 995 at once, also when unsure; no self-driving); SingHealth / National Heart Centre [Heart attack](https://www.singhealth.com.sg/symptoms-treatments/heart-attack) (ring 995 for an ambulance; do not drive); MOH & SCDF [joint release, 25 Feb 2022](https://www.moh.gov.sg/newsroom/covid-19-patients-to-please-make-use-of-scdf-emergency-medical-services-and-emergency-department-services-prudently/) (sudden chest pain is on its list of conditions for 995); [Singapore First Aid Guidelines 2026](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13516000/) (acute severe chest pain → activate emergency medical services, i.e. 995; ambulance, not private transport)
**US (quotable):** CDC U01; MedlinePlus U02, U22
referrals.note_zh: SCDF 自己的 995 页面示例清单里没有单列胸痛；MOH「Getting medical help」页写的是去急诊。上面四个新加坡来源都直接写 995。SHF 还写：糖尿病患者心梗可以完全没有胸痛。MOH & SCDF 那份是新冠时期的新闻稿，引用时带日期。急救指引里给急救员的阿司匹林用法属于用药指示，没有摘，app 不展示。

referrals.section: B1　马上打急救（新加坡 995）
referrals.situation: Sudden breathlessness or trouble breathing; lips, nails or skin turning blue, pale or grey; severe asthma attack
referrals.source:
**SG:** SCDF [Emergency Medical Services](https://www.scdf.gov.sg/home/about-scdf/emergency-medical-services) (breathlessness is one of its 995 examples); MOH & SCDF [joint release](https://www.moh.gov.sg/newsroom/covid-19-patients-to-please-make-use-of-scdf-emergency-medical-services-and-emergency-department-services-prudently/) (sudden breathlessness); Singapore National Asthma Programme [written asthma action plan](https://isomer-user-content.by.gov.sg/68/07f35664-f981-487e-8888-d278870901b7/Written%20Asthma%20Action%20Plan_English%20%28SNAP%29.pdf) (red zone — reliever needed again within three to four hours, breathing is hard, often woken by symptoms: see the doctor the same day, or ring 995 if needed)
**US (quotable):** CDC U10, U11
referrals.note_zh: 哮喘行动计划里的用药栏是空格，由医护填写，app 不展示任何用药内容。MOH「Getting medical help」页对呼吸困难写的是去急诊。

referrals.section: B1　马上打急救（新加坡 995）
referrals.situation: Stroke signs: face drooping on one side, arm weakness, slurred or strange speech, sudden loss of balance or vision, sudden severe headache — **even if the signs go away (TIA)**
referrals.refer_to: **995** — not a GP or polyclinic; do not drive yourself
referrals.source:
**SG:** HealthHub [Stroke](https://www.healthhub.sg/health-conditions/stroke-about-stroke) (every stroke and TIA is an emergency → 995; one F.A.S.T. sign is enough; reviewed 27 Aug 2026); SCDF [Emergency Handbook 2026](https://www.scdf.gov.sg/docs/default-source/comm.---volunteers-%28docs%29/2026-scdf-emergency-handbook%28eng%29_final.pdf) (F.A.S.T. → dial 995); SCDF EMS page; MOH & SCDF [joint release](https://www.moh.gov.sg/newsroom/covid-19-patients-to-please-make-use-of-scdf-emergency-medical-services-and-emergency-department-services-prudently/) (sudden weakness of a limb or the body, trouble speaking, drooping face)
**US (quotable):** CDC U03, U04
referrals.note_zh: 美国 CDC 对 TIA 写的是「马上告诉医疗团队」（U05），新加坡 HealthHub 写打 995 → 新加坡版按 995。

referrals.section: B1　马上打急救（新加坡 995）
referrals.situation: Collapse, unconscious or unresponsive, not breathing or only gasping (possible cardiac arrest)
referrals.refer_to: **995**, start CPR, send someone for an AED
referrals.singapore_contact: 995; myResponder app ("Call 995" sends your location; shows nearby AEDs)
referrals.source:
**SG:** SCDF [Emergency Handbook 2026](https://www.scdf.gov.sg/docs/default-source/comm.---volunteers-%28docs%29/2026-scdf-emergency-handbook%28eng%29_final.pdf) (no response → one person dials 995, another fetches the AED; the 995 centre coaches CPR by phone); SCDF [myResponder](https://www.scdf.gov.sg/home/community-and-volunteers/community-resources/myresponder-app); Singapore Heart Foundation [CPR + AED](https://www.myheart.org.sg/techniques/cpraed-for-adults/); SingHealth HealthXchange [If someone collapses](https://www.healthxchange.sg/explore/life-hacks/what-to-do-if-someone-collapse-become-unconscious) (2016)
**US (quotable):** CDC U06; MedlinePlus U07
referrals.note_zh: 手册里按压速度、深度这些技术数字没有摘。晕倒后已经醒来 → B2。

referrals.section: B1　马上打急救（新加坡 995）
referrals.situation: Severe allergic reaction: swelling of face, lips, tongue or throat; trouble breathing or swallowing; widespread hives with dizziness, fainting or a racing heartbeat
referrals.source:
**SG:** SCDF EMS page (severe allergy is in SCDF's "emergencies" tier; chart image, undated); NHG [Anaphylaxis](https://www.nhghealth.com.sg/find-care/Condition/anaphylaxis) (call 995); MOH [Hives](https://www.moh.gov.sg/seeking-healthcare/getting-medical-help/conditions/hives/) (with swelling or breathing trouble → A&E); MOH [side-effects infographic](https://isomer-user-content.by.gov.sg/3/da0850c3-5e4b-46a3-9401-b93df93f063a/know-how-to-manage-side-effects-of-medication.pdf)
**US (quotable):** MedlinePlus U08; CDC U29
referrals.note_zh: 七份 HealthHub 药物单张对药物过敏征兆（脸、眼、唇、舌肿；呼吸困难；全身痒疹）写的都是「停药并马上看医护人员」，没有写 995；升到 995 的依据是这一行的来源。MedlinePlus 那句「有自动注射笔就立刻注射」是给药指示，不展示。

referrals.section: B1　马上打急救（新加坡 995）
referrals.situation: Seizure / fit (esp. lasting more than 5 minutes, or repeated without waking)
referrals.source:
**SG:** SCDF EMS page (seizures); SCDF Emergency Handbook (fit → dial 995); MOH & SCDF [joint release](https://www.moh.gov.sg/newsroom/covid-19-patients-to-please-make-use-of-scdf-emergency-medical-services-and-emergency-department-services-prudently/) (unexplained jerking or fits)
**US (quotable):** MedlinePlus U23

referrals.section: B1　马上打急救（新加坡 995）
referrals.situation: Severe bleeding from an injury; bleeding that will not stop; coughing up or vomiting blood; black, sticky stools
referrals.source:
**SG:** SCDF EMS page (excessive bleeding); MOH & SCDF [joint release](https://www.moh.gov.sg/newsroom/covid-19-patients-to-please-make-use-of-scdf-emergency-medical-services-and-emergency-department-services-prudently/) (severe bleeding from injuries → 995; an ordinary cut that bleeds is listed as *not* life-threatening); MOH [Getting medical help](https://www.moh.gov.sg/seeking-healthcare/getting-medical-help/) (uncontrolled bleeding; coughing or vomiting blood → A&E); MOH [Abdominal pain](https://www.moh.gov.sg/seeking-healthcare/getting-medical-help/conditions/abdominal-pain-or-indigestion/) and [Diarrhoea & vomiting](https://www.moh.gov.sg/seeking-healthcare/getting-medical-help/conditions/diarrhoea-and-vomiting/) (blood in vomit, bloody or black sticky stools → A&E)
**US (quotable):** MedlinePlus U21
referrals.note_zh: 官方把「外伤大出血」和「割伤出血」分成两档，规则里也要分开。HealthHub 阿司匹林、布洛芬单张对严重出血征兆（尿血、黑便、大片瘀斑、咳血或咖啡渣样呕吐物、突然剧烈头痛伴恶心或昏倒）写的是「停药并马上告诉医护人员」。

referrals.section: B1　马上打急救（新加坡 995）
referrals.situation: Very low blood sugar with loss of consciousness or a seizure
referrals.source:
**SG:** HealthHub Diabetes Hub [Hypoglycaemia](https://www.healthhub.sg/programmes/diabetes-hub/hypoglycaemia) (unconscious → call an ambulance straight away; below 4.0 mmol/L counts as low)
**US (quotable):** CDC U16; NIDDK U18
referrals.note_zh: HealthHub 只对「失去意识」写叫救护车（没写号码，995 来自 SCDF）；它把虚弱、视物模糊、口齿不清、意识混乱、抽搐列为「自己处理不了」的严重症状，但没说这些要叫救护车——归 995 还是马上就医由团队定。新加坡用 mmol/L；美国页面的 mg/dL 数值不显示、不换算。NIDDK 条款：经过编辑的内容不得用来推荐转介，原样引用不算编辑，用不用由团队定。

referrals.section: B1　马上打急救（新加坡 995）
referrals.situation: Sudden confusion or drowsiness; sudden dizziness, numbness, weakness or change in vision; vomiting or diarrhoea that will not stop
referrals.source: **SG:** MOH & SCDF [joint release](https://www.moh.gov.sg/newsroom/covid-19-patients-to-please-make-use-of-scdf-emergency-medical-services-and-emergency-department-services-prudently/) (drowsiness or confusion → 995); MOH [Getting medical help](https://www.moh.gov.sg/seeking-healthcare/getting-medical-help/) and [When to visit the hospital for emergencies](https://www.moh.gov.sg/seeking-healthcare/getting-medical-help/visiting-the-hospital-for-emergencies/) (seven signs of a medical emergency → A&E)
referrals.note_zh: MOH 同页建议平时备一份家人正在吃的药的清单。

referrals.section: B1　马上打急救（新加坡 995）
referrals.situation: High blood pressure together with weakness or numbness, trouble seeing, speaking or walking, chest pain, shortness of breath, or severe giddiness or headache
referrals.source: **SG:** MOH [High blood pressure](https://www.moh.gov.sg/seeking-healthcare/getting-medical-help/conditions/high-blood-pressure/) (these signs → A&E; updated 2 Jan 2025)
referrals.note_zh: v1 这一行引的 MedlinePlus 美国血压分级（>180 / >120）在新加坡版不显示；留在附录 B.1（DP-I01）作背景。

referrals.section: B1　马上打急救（新加坡 995）
referrals.situation: Heat stroke: drowsy, confused or unconscious in the heat; seizures; very high body temperature
referrals.source:
**SG:** MOM [FAQs on heat stress](https://www.mom.gov.sg/heat-stress-measures-for-outdoor-work/faqs-on-heat-stress-measures-for-outdoor-work) (drowsy or unconscious → call 995; still alert → move to a cool, shaded, airy place, give cold fluids, remove extra clothing, cool with wet towels, cold water or ice packs; updated 28 Aug 2026); WSH Council [Heat stress management](https://www.tal.sg/wshc/topics/heat-stress/heat-stress-management) (signs of heat stroke → 995 ambulance straight away); Singapore Heart Foundation [Heat: the unseen heart threat](https://www.myheart.org.sg/heart-news/heat-the-unseen-heart-threat/) (passes out → 995); NUHS [Keep your cool](https://nuhsplus.edu.sg/article/why-it-s-important-to-keep-your-cool-in-singapore-s-hot-weather) (heat stroke is life-threatening and treated in an emergency department)
**US (quotable):** CDC / NIOSH U14
referrals.note_zh: 新加坡口径的分界是神志：昏沉或失去意识 → 995；还清醒 → 先降温补水（见 B2）。HealthHub 没有中暑专页，SCDF 2026 手册也没有中暑一节。MOM 页面写给「工人」，德士 / 私召车司机和外卖骑手多数是平台工人，另见 B5。

referrals.section: B1　马上打急救（新加坡 995）
referrals.situation: Took too much of a medicine / swallowed something poisonous
referrals.refer_to: Get medical help **straight away** — nearest medical facility, A&E, or **995**
referrals.singapore_contact: 995. No poison-information line for the public was found on any current official Singapore page
referrals.source: **SG:** HealthHub leaflets for all 7 drugs (took more than recommended → medical advice straight away), e.g. [Paracetamol](https://www.healthhub.sg/medication-devices-and-treatment/medications/paracetamol-oral); SingHealth Polyclinics [video-consult exclusions](https://polyclinic.singhealth.com.sg/our-clinic-services/shp-vc/general-medical-conditions) (drug overdose is an emergency → nearest medical facility, Emergency Department, or 995); [Singapore First Aid Guidelines 2021](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8804485/) (swallowed poison → activate emergency medical services at once; do not make the person vomit or give anything by mouth); SingHealth [Medical emergencies](https://www.singhealth.com.sg/symptoms-treatments/medical-emergencies); MOH [poisoning guideline, 2011](https://isomer-user-content.by.gov.sg/95/eaddd24b-b620-413d-b5aa-2f37663d7520/management-of-poisoning---booklet.pdf)
referrals.note_zh: 国家急救指引对「吞下毒物」写的是立即启动急救服务（即 995），没有附加条件；SingHealth Polyclinics 把药物过量列为急症。「呼吸停止或症状严重才打 995、轻症找 GP」的分法只出现在 2016 年一篇 SingHealth 文章里，这里没有采用。SGH 的药物与中毒咨询中心（6423 9119）2004–2008 年试点后已停，**不要放进 app**；美国说明书里的 Poison Control 1-800-222-1222 也不要放。2016 年一篇 SingHealth 文章说可以给水、果汁或牛奶，和 2021 年国家急救指引相反，以指引为准，app 不给任何「喝点什么」的建议。扑热息痛过量：HealthHub 单张列了肝损伤征兆。

referrals.section: B1　马上打急救（新加坡 995）
referrals.situation: Oximeter reading that stays below 92% on several readings at rest (MOH, COVID-19 advisory)
referrals.source:
**SG:** MOH on Ask.gov.sg [When should I seek emergency help?](https://ask.gov.sg/moh/questions/clhq0irrx00etjz08c6lhkavg) (also lists breathlessness, chest pain or pressure, a very fast or pounding heartbeat, new confusion, drowsiness or passing out); Temasek Foundation [oximeter release, 24 Jun 2021](https://temasekfoundation.org.sg/news/media-releases/One-Free-Oximeter-for-Every-Singapore-Household) (below 90% → A&E at once; 90–94% → consult a doctor)
**US (quotable):** MedlinePlus RT-02
referrals.note_zh: ⚠️ 三个来源的数值都不一样：MOH（新冠咨询语境）< 92% 且多次静息读数 → 995；淡马锡基金会 < 90% → 急诊；MedlinePlus ≤ 88% 立即就医。不要合并成一个数，要不要显示数值由团队定。

referrals.section: B1　马上打急救（新加坡 995）
referrals.situation: Signs of shock (cold and sweaty skin, rapid breathing, bluish skin, weak and rapid pulse)
referrals.source: **US (quotable):** NHLBI RT-30. No Singapore page found for this wording
referrals.note_zh: 只有美国来源。

referrals.section: B1　马上打急救（新加坡 995）
referrals.situation: Person at immediate risk of harming themselves or attempting suicide
referrals.source: See B4

referrals.section: B2　尽快看医生
referrals.situation: Blood pressure readings keep coming out higher than your usual, or giddiness / headache with high blood pressure
referrals.source:
**SG:** MOH [High blood pressure](https://www.moh.gov.sg/seeking-healthcare/getting-medical-help/conditions/high-blood-pressure/) (readings that stay above your usual, or giddiness or headache → GP; no numbers given); Singapore Heart Foundation [BP left or right arm](https://www.myheart.org.sg/heart-news/blood-pressure-left-or-right-arm/) (140/90 or higher on two or more occasions, 90/60 or lower, or a repeated arm-to-arm systolic gap over 10 mmHg → see a doctor)
**US (quotable):** CDC DP-D01, DP-D02
referrals.note_zh: MOH 没给数值，只说「比你平时的读数持续偏高」。新加坡临床指引里家测高血压切点是 135/85（诊室 140/90），见 ACE 指南和 Healthier SG 高血压诊疗规程（面向医生，L4）；数值要不要进 app 由团队定。

referrals.section: B2　尽快看医生
referrals.situation: Blood sugar keeps staying high (HealthHub: above 16 mmol/L) or symptoms of high blood sugar (thirst, passing urine often, blurred vision, slow-healing cuts…)
referrals.source:
**SG:** HealthHub [Hyperglycaemia](https://www.healthhub.sg/programmes/diabetes-hub/hyperglycaemia) (above 16 mmol/L that keeps staying high, or symptoms → medical advice); HealthHub [Self-monitoring of blood sugar](https://www.healthhub.sg/programmes/diabetes-hub/self-monitoring-of-blood-sugar) (general ranges in mmol/L; personal targets differ — discuss with the doctor or care team)
**US (quotable):** MedlinePlus DP-D06, DP-D07; CDC DP-D04, DP-D05
referrals.note_zh: 新加坡用 mmol/L，HealthHub 给了本地数值。美国页面的数值是 mg/dL，新加坡版不显示、不换算。目标值因人而异，要问医生。

referrals.section: B2　尽快看医生
referrals.situation: Low blood sugar that does not settle after the self-help steps are tried twice, or keeps happening
referrals.refer_to: **Doctor** (medicine review); A&E if the doctor cannot be reached and it is an emergency
referrals.source: HealthHub [Hypoglycaemia](https://www.healthhub.sg/programmes/diabetes-hub/hypoglycaemia)

referrals.section: B2　尽快看医生
referrals.situation: Low oximeter or tracker reading, worried about a reading, or symptoms getting worse (HPB tracker page: below 94% counts as low; Temasek Foundation release: 90–94% → consult a doctor)
referrals.source:
**SG:** HPB [fitness tracker features](https://www.healthhub.sg/programmes/healthyliving/fitnesstracker/features) (below 94% counts as low; see a doctor if worried; readings can be off); Temasek Foundation [oximeter release, 24 Jun 2021](https://temasekfoundation.org.sg/news/media-releases/One-Free-Oximeter-for-Every-Singapore-Household) (90–94% → consult a doctor)
**US (quotable):** MedlinePlus RT-01, RT-03, RT-04; FDA RT-05 – RT-10
referrals.note_zh: 多次静息读数都低于 92% → 见 B1。FDA：读数不是诊断；肤色、指甲油、血液循环等会影响准确度；一般健康类血氧仪没有经过临床决策用途的评估。各来源数值不同，不要合并。

referrals.section: B2　尽快看医生
referrals.situation: Palpitations that are frequent or long-lasting, or come with chest pain or dizziness; suspected irregular heartbeat (incl. from a smartwatch alert)
referrals.source: Singapore Heart Foundation [Stop the racing heart](https://www.myheart.org.sg/heart-news/stop-the-racing-heart/); HealthHub [Atrial fibrillation](https://www.healthhub.sg/health-conditions/atrial-fibrillation) (trackers, smartwatches and home BP monitors may miss AF → see a healthcare professional; reviewed 3 Jun 2026); MedlinePlus [Atrial fibrillation](https://medlineplus.gov/atrialfibrillation.html) (RT-13); NHLBI (RT-16 – RT-19)
referrals.note_zh: 心律失常伴胸痛 / 气促 → 995（RT-12, RT-14）。**没找到能带转介的心率数值来源**：NHLBI 给了 <60 / >100 次/分的定义，但同页有第三方动画版权声明（TBC）；A.D.A.M. 相关条目只能放链接（L5）。

referrals.section: B2　尽快看医生
referrals.situation: Symptoms of low blood pressure (dizzy or light-headed, fainting, blurry vision, tiredness)
referrals.source:
**SG:** Singapore Heart Foundation [BP left or right arm](https://www.myheart.org.sg/heart-news/blood-pressure-left-or-right-arm/) (readings that stay at 90/60 or lower → see a doctor); HealthHub [Postural hypotension](https://www.healthhub.sg/health-conditions/postural-hypotension) (symptoms after standing up; reviewed 18 Apr 2019; no referral wording)
**US (quotable):** NHLBI RT-31; MedlinePlus RT-27, RT-28
referrals.note_zh: 氯沙坦：美国说明书写觉得要晕、头晕 → 躺下，马上打给医生；新加坡单张只把起身时头晕列为常见副作用。低血压数值各来源不同（90/60；HealthHub 那页写 100/60），别合并。

referrals.section: B2　尽快看医生
referrals.situation: Felt faint, or fainted and came round
referrals.refer_to: Get checked by a **doctor** soon to find out why (ring 995 if you feel faint and nobody is nearby)
referrals.source:
**SG:** SingHealth Polyclinics doctors on HealthXchange, [Fainting: what to do](https://www.healthxchange.sg/how-to-manage/vasovagal-syncope/syncope-how-help) (2017)
**US (quotable):** MedlinePlus U13
referrals.note_zh: 倒下不醒、没呼吸 → B1。

referrals.section: B2　尽快看医生
referrals.situation: Clearly unwell, or side effects that are hard to cope with, after starting a medicine; the medicine seems to do harm or not work
referrals.refer_to: **Doctor** (do not stop on your own) — or pharmacist for side-effect questions
referrals.source:
**SG:** MOH [Know Your Meds infographics](https://www.moh.gov.sg/seeking-healthcare/managing-your-medication/) (side effects hard to manage → doctor or pharmacist); HealthHub medication leaflets (any worry or suspected side effect → doctor or pharmacist; check with a healthcare professional before stopping)
**US (quotable):** NIA DP-D08, DP-D09; FDA DP-D10, DP-D11
referrals.note_zh: 各药自己的「停药 / 就医」原话见表 A；过敏类急症见 B1。

referrals.section: B2　尽快看医生
referrals.situation: Fever of 38 °C or more that does not come down with OTC medicine, or lasts more than 3 days; fever while pregnant, just back from overseas, or on immune-suppressing medicine
referrals.source: MOH [Fever](https://www.moh.gov.sg/seeking-healthcare/getting-medical-help/conditions/fever/) (updated 3 Dec 2025); paracetamol / ibuprofen labels (DP-D15, DP-D16)
referrals.note_zh: 同页另列急诊征兆（呼吸困难、胸痛、剧烈头痛、咳血、全身痒疹、抽搐等）→ B1。

referrals.section: B2　尽快看医生
referrals.situation: Headache lasting more than a day despite painkillers, on more than 15 days a month, too strong for daily routine, after a head injury, or with nausea / vomiting
referrals.refer_to: **GP** (ED for stiff neck, confusion, weakness or numbness, blurred vision, trouble speaking, fits)
referrals.source: MOH [Headaches](https://www.moh.gov.sg/seeking-healthcare/getting-medical-help/conditions/headaches/)

referrals.section: B2　尽快看医生
referrals.situation: Self-treating with paracetamol or ibuprofen and not getting better: fever still there after 3 days, headache beyond 2 days, pain no better after 7 days, or anything getting worse
referrals.source:
**SG:** HealthHub [Paracetamol (Oral)](https://www.healthhub.sg/medication-devices-and-treatment/medications/paracetamol-oral) and [Ibuprofen (Oral)](https://www.healthhub.sg/medication-devices-and-treatment/medications/ibuprofen-oral) leaflets
**US (quotable):** MedlinePlus DP-D18; OTC labels DP-D15 – D17
referrals.note_zh: 美国标签的期限不同（疼痛 10 天、发烧 3 天），新加坡版按单张的 3 / 2 / 7 天，不展示美国那句。

referrals.section: B2　尽快看医生
referrals.situation: Breast changes: painless lump, nipple rash that won't go away, bleeding or unusual nipple discharge, swollen or thickened skin, skin dimpling, inward-turned nipple
referrals.source: HealthHub [Healthier SG Screening journey](https://www.healthhub.sg/programmes/healthiersg-screening/screening-journey?age_group=50-and-above&gender=female)

referrals.section: B2　尽快看医生
referrals.situation: Other common problems with GP-vs-ED thresholds (bruises, cold and flu, cuts and wounds, diarrhoea and vomiting, hives, insect bites, burns, nosebleeds, skin infection, sore eyes, sprains)
referrals.refer_to: **GP**; ED for the red flags each page lists
referrals.source: MOH [Getting medical help › Conditions](https://www.moh.gov.sg/seeking-healthcare/getting-medical-help/conditions/) (11 condition pages, each updated 2 Jan 2025; details in the research notes)
referrals.note_zh: 11 个页面里有 10 个（皮肤感染页除外）说药剂师也能给建议、并判断要不要去看 GP 或急诊。

referrals.section: B2　尽快看医生
referrals.situation: Feeling unwell in the heat but still alert: weak or dizzy, headache, strong thirst, nausea or vomiting, muscle cramps, palpitations, breathless
referrals.refer_to: Stop what you are doing, cool down and drink; **get medical attention** if it does not settle or gets worse
referrals.singapore_contact: Doctor / medical attention (the sources name no specific service); 995 if drowsy or passing out (B1)
referrals.source:
**SG:** WSH Council [Code of Practice for Platform Services](https://www.tal.sg/wshc/resources/publications/codes-of-practice/code-of-practice-for-platform-services), clause 8.2 (written for ride-hail drivers and delivery riders: feeling unwell → stop working and get medical attention; shelter in shade; keep hydrated; check the WBGT in the myENV app); MOM [FAQs on heat stress](https://www.mom.gov.sg/heat-stress-measures-for-outdoor-work/faqs-on-heat-stress-measures-for-outdoor-work) (early warning signs); NUHS [Keep your cool](https://nuhsplus.edu.sg/article/why-it-s-important-to-keep-your-cool-in-singapore-s-hot-weather) (symptoms that continue despite cooling and rehydrating need urgent medical attention); MOH / NEA [joint advisory, 20 Apr 2016](https://www.moh.gov.sg/newsroom/high-temperatures-experienced-in-past-few-days/)
**US (quotable):** CDC / NIOSH U15
referrals.note_zh: 平台服务守则是唯一直接针对司机 / 骑手的新加坡官方条文；它写的是平台「应该」做什么，随附问答说明这些措施不是强制的，app 不能说成法律义务。饮水量的数字是一般建议，医生交代过限水的人按医生说的。

referrals.section: B2　尽快看医生
referrals.situation: Has a heart condition or takes blood-pressure medicines and asks whether heat affects them more
referrals.refer_to: Explain only; **doctor** for anything about their own medicines
referrals.source: **SG:** Singapore Heart Foundation [Heat: the unseen heart threat](https://www.myheart.org.sg/heart-news/heat-the-unseen-heart-threat/) (people with cardiovascular conditions are more vulnerable in heat; some commonly prescribed medicine classes can reduce sweating; 2 Apr 2024)
referrals.note_zh: 文章只点了药物大类，没有点名具体药，也没有叫人停药或调药。app 只能解释「这类人在高温下要更留意身体状况」，不能推出任何用药建议。

referrals.section: B2　尽快看医生
referrals.situation: Urgent but not life-threatening, unsure where to go
referrals.singapore_contact: **6262 6262** — English only, voice only, free apart from call/data charges
referrals.source: Woodlands Health (NHG) [NurseFirst](https://www.nhghealth.com.sg/wh/clinical-care-services/nursefirst-helpline); MOH [995 → NurseFirst trial](https://www.moh.gov.sg/newsroom/nation-wide-trial-to-refer-non-life-threatening-995-calls-to-the-nursefirst-helpline/) (30 May 2025); MOH [CNY clinics release](https://www.moh.gov.sg/newsroom/close-to-1-100-general-practitioner-clinics-open-during-chinese-new-year/) (15 Feb 2026)
referrals.note_zh: ⚠️ 服务时间冲突：运营方页面写 24 小时（含公共假期）；MOH 2025-05-30 试点新闻稿和 2026-02-15 新闻稿都写早 8 点到晚 11 点，没找到改为 24 小时的公告。显示时间的话标出处和核对日期。995 被判定为非紧急的电话会转到 NurseFirst。

referrals.section: B3　问药师
referrals.situation: Missed a dose — take it now or skip?
referrals.refer_to: **Pharmacist** (and the drug's own label, Table A)
referrals.source:
**SG:** each HealthHub leaflet has its own missed-dose line (Table A); HealthHub [Remember to take your meds](https://www.healthhub.sg/medication-devices-and-treatment/handling-medications/remember-to-take-meds) (check the missed-dose part of Medications A–Z; ask a doctor or pharmacist; keep a record of missed doses; reviewed 3 Mar 2026)
**US (quotable):** FDA DP-P01; NIA DP-P02
referrals.note_zh: 新加坡单张的通用写法：想起就补；快到下一次就只吃平常那一次；不要双倍。二甲双胍、阿托伐他汀、氨氯地平的美国说明书与此不同（表 A）。

referrals.section: B3　问药师
referrals.situation: Wants to stop, reduce or switch a medicine (incl. "I feel fine now")
referrals.source:
**SG:** MOH [Medication review infographic](https://isomer-user-content.by.gov.sg/3/d8e180c6-c71b-45ea-b934-2d475ae197db/Know%20About%20Importance%20of%20Medication%20Review.pdf) (get a doctor's or pharmacist's go-ahead before stopping or changing a medicine; updated 30 Jun 2026); HealthHub leaflets for amlodipine, losartan, atorvastatin, aspirin and regular ibuprofen (check with a healthcare professional before stopping)
**US (quotable):** CDC DP-P04; NIA DP-P06; FDA DP-P05, DP-P07
referrals.note_zh: 例外是单张写明要停药的情形（过敏、肝损伤、肌肉分解、严重出血的征兆；氯沙坦发现怀孕），见表 A。「感觉好也要继续」正好对上出题人说的核心难点。

referrals.section: B3　问药师
referrals.situation: Can these medicines / supplements / traditional medicines be taken together?
referrals.source:
**SG:** MOH [Visiting a pharmacist](https://www.moh.gov.sg/seeking-healthcare/getting-medical-help/visiting-a-pharmacist/) (incl. vitamins, supplements and traditional medicines); HSA [Health supplements](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/announcements/health-supplement-regulations/); HealthHub leaflets (tell a healthcare professional about all other medicines, supplements, traditional and herbal products; the ibuprofen leaflet names aspirin, clopidogrel and warfarin and says not to combine NSAIDs; the atorvastatin leaflet names warfarin and some antibiotics and antifungals; the paracetamol leaflet names warfarin)
**US (quotable):** FDA DP-P09; NIA DP-P10; CDC DP-P11; MedlinePlus DP-P14 – P16; OTC labels DP-P19 – P21
referrals.note_zh: 与本项目直接相关的原话：布洛芬「为心梗/中风吃阿司匹林的人先问医生或药师」、阿司匹林「在吃痛风 / 糖尿病 / 关节炎处方药的先问」、扑热息痛「在吃华法林的先问」。FDA「Drug Interactions: What You Should Know」页有非政府合著方，许可待确认（没用）。

referrals.section: B3　问药师
referrals.situation: Not sure whether another product also contains paracetamol (risk of doubling up)
referrals.source: Paracetamol label (DP-P18)
referrals.note_zh: 新加坡 HealthHub 单张也提醒不要同时吃两种含扑热息痛的药（L4）。

referrals.section: B3　问药师
referrals.situation: Medicine looks different from before, brand changed, or the label doesn't match — or the app cannot recognise the medicine
referrals.source:
**SG:** MOH [Branded and generic medication](https://isomer-user-content.by.gov.sg/3/8605a193-93f8-4177-8259-74c096ffef1e/Know%20About%20Branded%20and%20Generic%20Medication.pdf) (the same medicine can come in brands that look different; identify it by name and strength; check with a doctor or pharmacist if unsure); HealthHub [Know about medication label](https://www.healthhub.sg/medication-devices-and-treatment/handling-medications/medication-label)
**US (quotable):** FDA DP-P27; NIA DP-P28; MedlinePlus DP-P29
referrals.note_zh: 在新加坡，「认不出的药」最常见的原因之一就是换了品牌。

referrals.section: B3　问药师
referrals.situation: Unsure how to take an OTC painkiller (esp. with allergies, other illnesses or other medicines)
referrals.source: MOH [Fever](https://www.moh.gov.sg/seeking-healthcare/getting-medical-help/conditions/fever/) / [Headaches](https://www.moh.gov.sg/seeking-healthcare/getting-medical-help/conditions/headaches/); MedlinePlus OTC (DP-P17)
referrals.note_zh: MOH 说药剂师还能判断要不要去看 GP 或急诊。

referrals.section: B3　问药师
referrals.situation: Wants to report a suspected side effect (Singapore)
referrals.refer_to: Tell your **doctor, dentist, pharmacist or nurse** — they report to HSA
referrals.source: HealthHub [Side effects from medicines](https://www.healthhub.sg/well-being-and-lifestyle/personal-care/side-effects-from-medicines) (by HSA); HSA [Adverse events](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/adverse-events/) (e-form is for healthcare professionals)
referrals.note_zh: 说明书里的 1-800-FDA-1088 是美国的，不显示。HealthHub 建议告诉医护：什么反应、药名、剂量和用了多久、包装上的批号、同期吃的其他产品（含保健品和中药）、其他病。

referrals.section: B3　问药师
referrals.situation: Does this medicine need a prescription? Where can I get it?
referrals.refer_to: **Doctor** for Prescription Only medicines; **pharmacist** for Pharmacy Only medicines; any retailer for General Sale List medicines
referrals.source: **SG:** HSA [How therapeutic products are regulated](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/announcements/therapeutic-products-regulation/) and [List of reclassified medicines](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/therapeutic-products/registration-of-therapeutic-products/variation-application/reclassification/list-of-reclassified-medicines/) (the three classes); HSA [register listing on data.gov.sg](https://data.gov.sg/datasets/d_767279312753558cbf19d48344577084/view) (class of each registered product; snapshot 7 Aug 2026)
referrals.note_zh: 七种药各自的分类见附录 S。买 Pharmacy Only 药时药剂师按法律要登记姓名、身份证号、联系方式和病情，app 可以提前告诉用户。最新分类以 HSA Infosearch 为准。

referrals.section: B3　问药师
referrals.situation: Medicine bought online or overseas, or passed on by a relative or friend; or a pack the app cannot match
referrals.source: **SG:** HSA [Buying health products online](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/announcements/stay-safe-buying-health-products-online/); HSA [advisory, 25 Sep 2026](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/announcements/risks-of-obtaining-prescription-medicines-unauthorised-channels/) (prescription medicines from overseas sellers, online platforms or well-meaning friends and relatives count as unauthorised sources); HSA [Travelling with medications](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/travelling-with-medication-and-medical-devices/personal-medications/) (medicines bought overseas have not been evaluated by HSA)
referrals.note_zh: app 不要根据用户描述的包装去「认药」：HSA 说假药的名称和包装可以和正品很像。出现过敏或副作用，HSA 的说法是马上停用并看医生。

referrals.section: B3　问药师
referrals.situation: Wants to know what a medicine is for, or which name and strength it is
referrals.source: **SG:** HealthHub [Know about medication label](https://www.healthhub.sg/medication-devices-and-treatment/handling-medications/medication-label) (name and strength are on the label and the strip or pack; reviewed 3 Mar 2026); HealthHub [Medications A–Z](https://www.healthhub.sg/medication-devices-and-treatment/medications); HSA [Infosearch](https://www.hsa.gov.sg/e-services/infosearch/) (registration status and current class)
referrals.note_zh: 同页提醒不要把自己的药给别人用。HSA Infosearch 要输验证码，app 不能自动查。

referrals.section: B3　问药师
referrals.situation: Taking a cold-and-flu product together with paracetamol, or a pack that lists "acetaminophen"
referrals.source:
**SG:** HealthHub [Paracetamol (Oral)](https://www.healthhub.sg/medication-devices-and-treatment/medications/paracetamol-oral) (never two paracetamol-containing products together; acetaminophen is another name for it); HealthHub [Common cold](https://www.healthhub.sg/health-conditions/common-cold) (combination cold products can double up on an ingredient; read the ingredient lists and check with a pharmacist; reviewed 8 Jan 2026)
**US (quotable):** paracetamol label DP-P18
referrals.note_zh: 新加坡注册的含扑热息痛产品里有 9 个成分栏写的是 acetaminophen。

referrals.section: B4　说出想伤害自己或想自杀（单列）
referrals.situation: User says they want to hurt themselves or die, or is in immediate danger
referrals.singapore_contact: **995** (SCDF ambulance) · Police **999** / SMS **70999** if unsafe to talk
referrals.source: SOS [Our services](https://www.sos.org.sg/our-services/); mindline.sg [Get help](https://www.mindline.sg/get-help); mindline.sg [1771](https://www.mindline.sg/1771); SPF [Contact us](https://www.police.gov.sg/Contact-Us) (999 / SMS 70999)
referrals.note_zh: SOS 和 mindline 都写：有即时危险打 995 或去急诊。

referrals.section: B4　说出想伤害自己或想自杀（单列）
referrals.situation: Wants to talk to someone now (any time)
referrals.singapore_contact:
**SOS 1767** — 24 h, every day, toll-free, can stay anonymous
**SOS CareText (WhatsApp) 9151 1767** — 24 h, text only, English only (calling this number does not reach SOS)
referrals.source: SOS [Our services](https://www.sos.org.sg/our-services/), [FAQ](https://www.sos.org.sg/faq/), [Contact](https://www.sos.org.sg/contact-us/)
referrals.note_zh: SOS 义工给情绪支持，不给专业建议；非英语服务看当班义工。SOS 的邮件服务 CareMail 已于 2026-04-01 停止。

referrals.section: B4　说出想伤害自己或想自杀（单列）
referrals.situation: Emotional distress or mental-health worry (for self or someone else), any age
referrals.singapore_contact: **Call 1771 · WhatsApp +65 6669 1771 · web chat on mindline.sg** — round the clock; **not toll-free** (standard call charges)
referrals.source: MOH [launch release, 18 Jun 2025](https://www.moh.gov.sg/newsroom/national-mindline-1771-to-provide--round-the-clock-support-for-mental-health/); mindline.sg [1771](https://www.mindline.sg/1771)
referrals.note_zh: 主办：MOH 国家心理健康办公室的项目；可匿名，不需要诊断或转介。收费：页面标题写 Free，但可见页脚和 IMH 联系页都写「不是免费电话」→ 写 not toll-free。1771 条款写明它不是急救服务。

referrals.section: B4　说出想伤害自己或想自杀（单列）
referrals.situation: Prefers Mandarin
referrals.singapore_contact: **Care Corner 1800-3535-800** — 10 am–10 pm daily, closed on public holidays
referrals.source: [Care Corner](https://www.carecorner.org.sg/services/toll-free-counselling-hotline/)
referrals.note_zh: SOS FAQ 也把没有华语义工时的来电转介到这里。

referrals.section: B4　说出想伤害自己或想自杀（单列）
referrals.situation: Other official options (office hours / specific groups)
referrals.singapore_contact: Silver Ribbon **6386 1928** (Mon–Fri 9 am–5 pm) · SAMH **1800-283-7019** (hours not stated) · CHAT (ages 16–30, assessment service, not a crisis line; 6493 6500 / 01) · Tinkle Friend **1800-2744-788** (children 13 and under; limited hours) · IMH Emergency Services (24 h, 10 Buangkok View; IMH main line 6389 2000)
referrals.source: mindline.sg [Get help](https://www.mindline.sg/get-help); [Silver Ribbon](https://www.silverribbonsingapore.com/); [SAMH](https://www.samhealth.org.sg/about-samh/contact-us/); [CHAT](https://www.nhghealth.com.sg/imh/chat/get-help); [Tinkle Friend](https://www.tinklefriend.sg/); [IMH contact](https://www.nhghealth.com.sg/imh/about-us/contact-us)
referrals.note_zh: 目标人群都是成人，Tinkle Friend 基本用不上，留作参考。

referrals.section: B4　说出想伤害自己或想自杀（单列）
referrals.situation: **Do not display** (retired or stale numbers)
referrals.singapore_contact: IMH Mental Health Helpline **6389 2222** (stopped when 1771 launched in June 2025; forwarding ended 30 Sep 2025) · National CARE Hotline (ceased 31 Dec 2022) · SOS old number **1800-221-4444** (SOS pages now show 1767; status of the old line unclear)
referrals.source: NHG [news, 18 Jun 2025](https://www.nhghealth.com.sg/News/help-at-hand-with-launch-of-national-mental-health-call-and-textline); MSF [notice](https://www.msf.gov.sg/media-room/article/National-Care-Hotline-to-Cease-Operations-from-31-December-2022)
referrals.note_zh: 仍在用旧号码的官方页：gov.sg 的 SGSecure「Useful links」页（2026-04-21 更新，仍写 SOS 1800 221 4444、IMH 6389 2222）；SOS 自己的服务条款页仍提 6389 2222；IMH CHAT 自杀页写「Call 999」（999 是警察，救护车是 995）。都别照抄。

referrals.section: B4　说出想伤害自己或想自杀（单列）
referrals.situation: Warning signs to recognise (for rule keywords)
referrals.source: NIMH [Warning signs of suicide](https://www.nimh.nih.gov/health/publications/warning-signs-of-suicide) (U25); MedlinePlus [Suicide](https://medlineplus.gov/suicide.html) (U27); CDC [Preventing suicide](https://www.cdc.gov/suicide/prevention/index.html) (U28)
referrals.note_zh: 原文见附录 B.1；美国 988 热线不显示。MedlinePlus 列的「囤积药片」对吃药人群特别相关。

referrals.section: B5　其他新加坡号码和服务
referrals.situation: Deaf, hard-of-hearing or speech-impaired person needs an ambulance or fire engine
referrals.source: SCDF [EMS page](https://www.scdf.gov.sg/home/about-scdf/emergency-medical-services); SCDF Emergency Handbook 2026
referrals.note_zh: 页面说自动回复发给「已登记的」用户，但没说怎么登记、不登记能不能用（第 5 节）。能说话的人请打 995。

referrals.section: B5　其他新加坡号码和服务
referrals.situation: Non-emergency ambulance transport
referrals.singapore_contact: **1777 only until 31 Dec 2026** (charged); from 1 Jan 2027: [go.gov.sg/pao](https://go.gov.sg/pao) → MOH [private ambulance services](https://www.moh.gov.sg/seeking-healthcare/find-a-facility-or-service/private-ambulance-services/)
referrals.source: MOH [1777 to cease from 1 Jan 2027](https://www.moh.gov.sg/newsroom/1777-non-emergency-ambulance-hotline-to-cease--from-1-january-2027/) (1 Jul 2026); SCDF EMS page
referrals.note_zh: **app 里别写死 1777**。SCDF 送非紧急个案收 $274。

referrals.section: B5　其他新加坡号码和服务
referrals.situation: Mild-to-moderate problem, want to avoid A&E
referrals.refer_to: **GP first** (GPFirst: referred patients get $50 off the ED fee and are seen before non-emergency cases); 24-hour Urgent Care Centre
referrals.singapore_contact: GP / polyclinic; Alexandra Hospital UCC (24 h)
referrals.source: MOH [GPFirst](https://www.moh.gov.sg/seeking-healthcare/getting-medical-help/gpfirst/); Alexandra Hospital [UCC](https://www.ah.com.sg/our-services/urgent-care-centre)
referrals.note_zh: 综合诊疗所时间（工作日 8:00–16:30、周六上午）来自 MOH 2024 年的读者回复，可能已变。

referrals.section: B5　其他新加坡号码和服务
referrals.situation: Police
referrals.singapore_contact: **999**; SMS **70999** when unsafe to talk; Police Hotline 1800 255 0000 (crime information, not emergency)
referrals.source: SPF [Contact us](https://www.police.gov.sg/Contact-Us)

referrals.section: B5　其他新加坡号码和服务
referrals.situation: Other numbers that are **not** emergency lines
referrals.singapore_contact: SCDF general hotline 1800 280 0000 · HPB HealthLine 1800 223 1313 (screening questions; FIT follow-up) · GPFirst hospital enquiry lines on MOH's "Seeking a doctor" page
referrals.source: SCDF [Contact us](https://www.scdf.gov.sg/home/contact-us); HealthHub screening journey; MOH [Seeking a doctor](https://www.moh.gov.sg/seeking-healthcare/getting-medical-help/seeking-a-doctor/)
referrals.note_zh: 不要当急救号码用。

referrals.section: B5　其他新加坡号码和服务
referrals.situation: Wants to know today's heat stress level before working outdoors or on the road
referrals.refer_to: Check the level; outdoor workers follow MOM guidance
referrals.source: **SG:** NEA / MSS [Heat Stress Advisory poster](https://www.weather.gov.sg/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Manage-HeatStress-Eng_updated.pdf) (three levels by WBGT: Low under 31 °C, Moderate 31 to under 33 °C, High 33 °C or above; June 2026); MOM [Heat stress measures for outdoor work](https://www.mom.gov.sg/heat-stress-measures-for-outdoor-work) (updated 28 Aug 2026)
referrals.note_zh: WBGT 是综合了气温、湿度、风和日晒的读数，不是气温，不能和天气预报的温度互换。咨询针对一般公众的长时间户外活动；MOM 那页是雇主义务，司机和骑手多为平台工人，不直接适用（见 B2 平台服务守则）。
